description: Fee APR over the last complete day for each pool this manager is configured with, best first. Only the manager's own pools are candidates: a move can target a pool only if the owner fixed it into the set when the manager was created. Pools that could not be scored are listed separately with the reason — a pool missing from the ranking is not a bad pool.

chainId.description: EVM chain id, e.g. 42161 for Arbitrum One

name: rank_pools
title: Rank a manager's pools by what they are paying
